en.label: English
en.title: MyAnimeDex – Anime Tracker: Episodes, Airing Calendar & Ranked Lists
en.description: Track every episode, never miss an airing, rank your favorites and level up. MyAnimeDex is the free anime tracker for iPhone and Android.
en.heroPitch: Track every episode, catch every new drop and rank everything you've watched, in one fast anime app.
en.s1Body: Tap + when an episode ends. Progress bars fill up, and a show moves to Completed on its own after the last episode.
en.s2Body: A weekly airing calendar in your own time zone, with live countdowns to the next episode. Filter it to just your favorites.
en.s3Body: Build ranked lists, drag to reorder, add your score and a one-line take. Invite friends to build a list together.
en.s4Body: Every anime you add, watch or favorite earns XP. Climb the ranks from Rookie to Kami and see where you stand on the leaderboard.
en.s5Body: The dice picks an anime you haven't added yet, with score, genres and synopsis. Not feeling it? Roll again.
en.s6Body: Favorites, filters and sorting in one grid. Dark or light theme, in 15 languages.
en.ctaBody: Free to download. Your lists sync across devices.
en.trademarks: Apple and the Apple logo are trademarks of Apple Inc. Google Play and the Google Play logo are trademarks of Google LLC.
en.featureList: Episode tracking, Airing calendar, Ranked and shared lists, XP and ranks, Dice roll recommendations
en.playTitle: Don't just read about it. Play it.
en.trackHint: Tap + to watch the next episode. Finish the show for bonus XP.

en.ctaXpZero: Free to download. Your lists sync across devices.
en.hero2Pitch: The anime companion that remembers your episode, counts down to every new drop and turns everything you watch into ranked lists and XP.
en.contactLede: Questions, bug reports, account help or ideas for the app. Send us a message and we'll get back to you.
en.formPrivacy: We only use your details to reply to this message. See our Privacy Policy.

en.jsError: Couldn't send right now. Please email us at support@myanimedex.com.
en.contactReplyBody: We usually reply within 1–2 business days.
en.contactAccountBody: You can delete your account yourself in the app.
en.newTitle: Your stats. Your style. Your week.
en.newLede: See what your list says about your taste, make your profile your own and never miss the next episode.
en.n1Body: Genre and studio breakdowns, your favorite studio and how your ratings compare with the community.
en.n2Body: App themes, avatar frames, profile banners and a My Top 10 showcase on your profile.
en.n3Body: Free reminders when your favorites air. Premium adds My Week, reminder settings and your phone calendar.

faq.a: Yes. Tracking, the airing calendar, episode reminders, lists and Arena are free. The free version shows ads. Premium is optional: it adds My Stats, themes and more, and removes ads.

faq.q: Can I import my MyAnimeList or AniList list?
faq.a: Yes. Open Profile, then Data & Backup, and import from MyAnimeList or AniList. Statuses, progress, dates and scores come along. Importing is free.
No. You can browse anime, the airing calendar and Arena as a guest. Sign in with Apple, Google or email when you want to save your list; it then syncs across your devices.
Add an anime to your favorites and turn on reminders in the Calendar tab. MyAnimeDex notifies you when a new episode of that anime airs, in your own time zone.

faq.q: Where does the anime data come from?
faq.a: Titles, episodes, airing times and scores come from AniList, one of the largest anime databases.

faq.q: Which devices and languages are supported?
faq.a: iPhone and iPad with iOS 15.1 or later, and Android phones. The app is available in 15 languages: English, Turkish, Japanese, Russian, German, Arabic, Spanish, Portuguese, Indonesian, Hindi, French, Italian, Polish, Vietnamese and Thai.

faq.a: Evet. Bölüm takibi, yayın takvimi, bölüm hatırlatıcıları, listeler ve Arena ücretsiz. Ücretsiz sürümde reklam gösterilir. Premium isteğe bağlı: İstatistiklerim, temalar ve daha fazlasını ekler, reklamları kaldırır.

faq.q: MyAnimeList veya AniList listemi aktarabilir miyim?
faq.a: Evet. Profil > Veri ve Yedekleme'ye gir, MyAnimeList veya AniList'ten içe aktar. Durumlar, ilerleme, tarihler ve puanlar da gelir. İçe aktarma ücretsiz.
Hayır. Animeleri, yayın takvimini ve Arena'yı misafir olarak gezebilirsin. Listeni kaydetmek istediğinde Apple, Google veya e-postayla giriş yap; listen cihazların arasında senkronize olur.
Bir animeyi favorilerine ekle ve Takvim sekmesinde hatırlatıcıları aç. O animenin yeni bölümü yayınlandığında MyAnimeDex sana kendi saat diliminde bildirim gönderir.
Başlıklar, bölümler, yayın saatleri ve puanlar en büyük anime veritabanlarından biri olan AniList'ten gelir.

iOS 15.1 ve üzeri iPhone ve iPad ile Android telefonlar. Uygulama 15 dilde: İngilizce, Türkçe, Japonca, Rusça, Almanca, Arapça, İspanyolca, Portekizce, Endonezce, Hintçe, Fransızca, İtalyanca, Lehçe, Vietnamca ve Tayca.

faq.a: はい。視聴記録、放送カレンダー、エピソード通知、リスト、アリーナは無料です。無料版には広告が表示されます。プレミアムは任意で、マイ統計やテーマなどが追加され、広告も表示されなくなります。

faq.q: MyAnimeListやAniListのリストを移行できますか？
faq.a: はい。プロフィール→データとバックアップから、MyAnimeListまたはAniListのリストをインポートできます。ステータス、進捗、日付、スコアも引き継がれます。インポートは無料です。

faq.q: アカウントは必要ですか？
faq.a: いいえ。ゲストとしてアニメ、放送カレンダー、アリーナを利用できます。リストを保存したいときに、Apple・Google・メールでログインすると、端末間で同期されます。

faq.q: エピソード通知はどう使いますか？
faq.a: アニメをお気に入りに追加し、カレンダータブで通知をオンにします。そのアニメの新エピソードが放送されると、あなたのタイムゾーンでお知らせします。

faq.q: アニメのデータはどこから来ていますか？
faq.a: タイトル、エピソード、放送時間、スコアは、最大級のアニメデータベースであるAniListから取得しています。
iOS 15.1以降のiPhone・iPadと、Androidスマートフォンに対応しています。アプリは日本語、英語、トルコ語、ロシア語、ドイツ語、アラビア語、スペイン語、ポルトガル語、インドネシア語、ヒンディー語、フランス語、イタリア語、ポーランド語、ベトナム語、タイ語の15言語で使えます。

Tambahkan anime ke favorit dan aktifkan pengingat di tab Kalender. MyAnimeDex memberi tahu kamu saat episode baru anime itu tayang, sesuai zona waktumu.

es.title: MyAnimeDex – Tracker de anime: episodios, calendario de estrenos y listas con ranking
es.description: Sigue cada episodio, no te pierdas ningún estreno, haz rankings de tus favoritos y sube de nivel. MyAnimeDex es el tracker de anime gratis para iPhone y Android.

es.s5Body: El dado elige un anime que aún no has añadido, con nota, géneros y sinopsis. ¿No te convence? Tira otra vez.

es.ctaBody: Descarga gratis. Tus listas se sincronizan entre dispositivos.

faq.q: Можно ли импортировать список из MyAnimeList или AniList?
faq.a: Да. Откройте Профиль → Данные и резервная копия и импортируйте из MyAnimeList или AniList. Статусы, прогресс, даты и оценки переносятся. Импорт бесплатный.
Нет. Аниме, календарь и Арену можно смотреть как гость. Войдите через Apple, Google или эл. почту, когда захотите сохранить список; он синхронизируется между устройствами.
Добавьте аниме в избранное и включите напоминания на вкладке «Календарь». MyAnimeDex сообщит, когда выйдет новая серия, в вашем часовом поясе.
Названия, серии, время выхода и оценки — из AniList, одной из крупнейших баз данных аниме.

iPhone и iPad с iOS 15.1 или новее и смартфоны на Android. Приложение доступно на 15 языках: русском, английском, турецком, японском, немецком, арабском, испанском, португальском, индонезийском, хинди, французском, итальянском, польском, вьетнамском и тайском.
